_about: Round 12: external research -> IS diagnostics; stage-B hypotheses (FIX/SIDE/ROUND/DISP/AFPART) failed their pre-registered IS gates and were not coded. Run: fill-realism stress (reported, not judged), CORR2 half-size second pair (gate missed on n by one; knob existed; H7 passed in r11), and the K-block of untested v0.7 knobs. Judge: IS (<=2025) t>=2 on R_w; OOS 2026 w_avgR and w_maxDD not worse than V5; better in >=2 of 3 years.
